item.title: 苹果第四财季营收增长 12%，服务收入再创新高
item.guid: 苹果第四财季营收增长-12%，服务收入再创新高
item.description:
Apple announced its fourth-quarter fiscal year 2026 results as of September 26: revenue of $114.477 billion, a 12% year-over-year increase; net profit of $30.711 billion, diluted earnings per share of $2.10, a 14% year-over-year increase. This is the first quarterly report since John Ternus took office as CEO. 苹果公布截至 9 月 26 日的 2026 财年第四季度业绩：营收 1144.77 亿美元，同比增长 12%；净利润 307.11 亿美元，稀释后每股收益 2.10 美元，同比增长 14%。 这是 John Ternus 出任 CEO 后交出的首份季度成绩单。

Performance across various business segments showed divergence: 各业务表现出现分化：

  • iPhone revenue was $57.583 billion, setting a record for the same period in previous years; Mac revenue was $10.792 billion. iPhone 营收 575.83 亿美元，创历年同期纪录；Mac 营收 107.92 亿美元。
  • Services revenue was $31.573 billion, a new historical high; iPad revenue was $6.229 billion, and wearables, home, and accessories revenue was $8.3 billion. 服务营收 315.73 亿美元，创历史新高；iPad 营收 62.29 亿美元，可穿戴、家居及配件营收 83 亿美元。
  • Greater China revenue was $17.539 billion, compared to $14.493 billion in the same period last year. 大中华区营收 175.39 亿美元，上年同期为 144.93 亿美元。

During the subsequent earnings call, John Ternus stated that Apple's Mac computer sales reached a new historical high this year. Ternus mentioned that Apple is currently advancing the commercialization of its AI capabilities, and some server-side AI features will have usage limits to encourage users with higher usage demands to subscribe to iCloud+. 在随后的财报电话会上，John Ternus 表示，苹果今年 Mac 电脑销量创下历史新高。Ternus 表示，苹果目前正推进 AI 能力的商业化，部分基于服务器端的 AI 功能将设置使用上限，以推动有更高使用需求的用户订阅 iCloud+。

Ternus repeatedly spoke about the new version of Siri, calling it "the Siri we've always wanted." 特努斯多次谈到新版 Siri，称其为「我们一直想要的 Siri」。

Management expects Apple's total revenue for the December quarter of 2026 to grow by 7% to 10% year-over-year, setting a new company record for quarterly revenue; services business revenue is expected to grow by 8% to 9% year-over-year. 管理层预计，2026 年 12 月季度苹果总营收将同比增长 7% 至 10%，并创下公司历史最高季度营收；服务业务营收预计同比增长 8% 至 9%。

item.title: 曝下一代触屏 MacBook Pro 将换新模具
item.guid: 曝下一代触屏-MacBook-Pro-将换新模具
item.description:
Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman revealed in his November 1st Power On newsletter that Apple plans to launch a second-generation touchscreen MacBook Pro next year, featuring M7 Pro and M7 Max chips, and incorporating new AI hardware capabilities. 彭博社记者马克·古尔曼在 11 月 1 日的 Power On 通讯中透露，苹果计划明年推出第二代触屏 MacBook Pro，搭载 M7 Pro 和 M7 Max 芯片，并加入新的 AI 硬件能力。

Apple is also developing an entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro equipped with a standard M7 chip, which will adopt the thinner and lighter body and narrower bezels introduced by the high-end version last week. 苹果还在开发配备标准 M7 芯片的入门级 14 英寸 MacBook Pro，将采用高端版本上周引入的更轻薄机身和更窄边框。

Currently, the non-touchscreen high-end versions equipped with M5 Pro and M5 Max are still on sale. Regarding whether this product line will continue to be updated, Gurman believes that maintaining two sets of high-end models simultaneously would increase engineering, marketing, and manufacturing burdens, so he expects the future lineup to gradually merge. 目前，搭载 M5 Pro、M5 Max 的非触屏高端版本仍在销售。对于这条产品线是否继续更新，古尔曼判断，同时维护两套高端机型会增加工程、营销和制造负担，因此他预计未来阵容将逐步合并。

item.title: 下一代 GPT 或将近期发布，OpenAI 用 1 万个 AI 智能体协作科研
item.guid: 下一代-GPT-或将近期发布，OpenAI-用-1-万个-AI-智能体协作科研
item.description:
According to Reuters, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman revealed yesterday at the ADIPEC 2026 energy conference in Abu Dhabi that the next generation of GPT that OpenAI is preparing to release might be the internal model previously used to study the Navier-Stokes equations. 据路透社报道，OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 昨日在阿布扎比举行的 ADIPEC 2026 能源大会上透露，OpenAI 正在准备发布的下一代 GPT，可能正是此前用于研究纳维–斯托克斯方程的内部模型。

Altman stated that approximately 10,000 AI agents driven by this model participated in the research, collaborating continuously for about 4 days without a traditional hierarchical structure or unified leader. Altman 称， 参与这项研究的是约 1 万个由该模型驱动的 AI 智能体，它们连续协作约 4 天，没有传统的层级结构或统一负责人。

OpenAI's research published in September this year stated that its model constructed a set of mathematical proofs attempting to show that under the condition of applying a smooth external force, a fluid that is initially static and has a smooth motion state may form a singularity within a finite time. OpenAI 今年 9 月公布的研究称，其模型构建了一套数学证明，尝试说明在施加平滑外力的条件下，一个最初静止且运动状态平滑的流体，可能在有限时间内形成奇点。

The research revolves around the Navier-Stokes equations, a problem that is one of the seven Millennium Prize Problems posed by the Clay Mathematics Institute. 该研究围绕纳维–斯托克斯方程展开，这一问题属于克雷数学研究所提出的七大千禧年数学难题之一。

According to reports, the relevant experiment started on September 1st, with approximately 10,000 AI agents completing core mathematical exploration within 88 hours, exchanging about 2.7 million messages and generating about 130 billion tokens. Subsequently, GPT-6 Astra spent about 17 hours completing formalization and verification work through Lean. 据报道，相关实验从 9 月 1 日启动，约 1 万个 AI 智能体在 88 小时内完成核心数学探索，期间交换约 270 万条消息，生成约 1300 亿 Token。随后，GPT-6 Astra 花费约 17 小时，通过 Lean 完成形式化和验证工作。

item.title: OpenAI 推出电网保护计划，拟让未来园区在用电紧张时降载
item.guid: OpenAI-推出电网保护计划，拟让未来园区在用电紧张时降载
item.description:
OpenAI announced the launch of the Grid Protectors Program, planning to collaborate with power companies, regulators, and policymakers to enable future computing power campuses to reduce electricity consumption when the grid is under pressure. Agreements in various regions will determine the load reduction scale, response speed, and duration respectively. OpenAI 宣布推出 Grid Protectors Program，计划与电力公司、监管机构及政策制定者合作，让未来建设的算力园区在电网承压时减少用电。各地协议将分别确定降载规模、响应速度和持续时间。

When equipment and local grid conditions permit, the company also plans to use on-site generation or energy storage at the campus to supply power to the grid, and smooth load changes through battery and power control systems. OpenAI stated that campuses should bear their own electricity consumption and supporting infrastructure costs, avoiding subsidies from households and small businesses. 在设备及当地电网条件允许时，公司还计划利用园区现场发电或储能向电网供电，并通过电池及电力控制系统平滑负荷变化。OpenAI 表示，园区应承担自身用电及配套基础设施成本，避免由家庭和小企业补贴。

The proposed campus in Effingham County, Georgia, will serve as a pilot. OpenAI's agreement with Georgia Power includes flexible demand response arrangements up to 1000 MW, allowing the campus to reduce power consumption when the grid needs it after it becomes operational. The company plans to use this as a starting point to extend similar arrangements to future campuses. 佐治亚州 Effingham County 的拟建园区将成为试点。OpenAI 与 Georgia Power 的协议包含最高 1000 兆瓦的灵活需求响应安排，园区投运后可在电网需要时减少取电。公司计划以此为起点，将类似安排扩展至未来园区。

item.title: 机器人登泰山大赛收官，宇树 A2 全自主夺得竞速冠军
item.guid: 机器人登泰山大赛收官，宇树-A2-全自主夺得竞速冠军
item.description:
The first CMG World Robot Mount Tai Climbing Competition was held on November 2nd in Tai'an, Shandong. Robots challenged a real mountain path from Hongmen to Zhongtianmen, covering approximately 3.9 kilometers, over 3100 steps, and an altitude difference of about 600 meters. Unitree Robotics announced that its participating teams won 1 gold and 2 silver medals, only competing in the legged robot speed and load-bearing categories this time. 首届 CMG 世界机器人登泰山大赛 11 月 2 日在山东泰安举行，机器人沿红门至中天门的真实山道，挑战约 3.9 公里、3100 余级台阶和约 600 米高差。宇树科技公布，其参赛队伍共获得 1 金 2 银，本次只参加足式机器人竞速和负重两个项目。

Beijing Lingyi Team's A2 robot dog won the legged robot speed championship in full autonomous mode, with an actual time of 41 minutes and 41 seconds, and a final score of 43 minutes and 41 seconds after adding a 2-minute penalty. Shanghai Gaoyi Team also used A2, winning the speed runner-up in full autonomous mode, with an actual time of 47 minutes and 07 seconds, and a final score of 54 minutes and 07 seconds after including a 7-minute penalty. 北京灵翌队的 A2 机器狗以全程全自主模式夺得足式机器人竞速冠军，实际用时 41 分 41 秒，加上 2 分钟罚时后的最终成绩为 43 分 41 秒。上海高翌队同样使用 A2，以全程全自主模式获得竞速亚军，实际用时 47 分 07 秒，计入 7 分钟罚时后为 54 分 07 秒。

According to Unitree, due to time and energy constraints, Unitree officially only sent two quadruped robots, A2 and B2, to participate. Many independent teams also spontaneously participated after secondary development based on Unitree products, among which the "heatstroke" retired G1 robot, which received a lot of attention, was entered by its developer. 据宇树介绍，由于时间精力限制，宇树官方仅派出 A2、B2 两款四足机器人参赛。还有众多独立团队基于宇树产品二次开发后自发参赛，其中受到大量关注的「中暑」退赛 G1 机器人为开发者参赛。

The competition also features projects such as humanoid robot racing and exoskeleton robot assistance. The load-bearing competition simulates the transportation scenarios of Mount Tai porters, testing the robots' ability to move, cross steps, and complete material transfer under load. 赛事还设置人形机器人竞速、外骨骼机器人助力等项目。负重赛模拟泰山挑山工的运输场景，检验机器人在负载条件下行进、跨越台阶和完成物资转运的能力。

item.title: iOS 限制后百度网盘仍可摇一摇跳广告，知情人士称新版待审核
item.guid: iOS-限制后百度网盘仍可摇一摇跳广告，知情人士称新版待审核
item.description:
After upgrading iPhone to iOS 27.2 and adding Baidu Netdisk to the "Restrict Motion Data" list, the splash screen shake-to-jump advertisement can still trigger a redirect. iPhone 升级至 iOS 27.2，并将百度网盘加入「限制动作数据」名单后，开屏摇一摇广告仍可触发跳转。

An informed source told The Paper that it's not that Baidu Netdisk intentionally bypassed this feature, but rather that the adaptation for the new version has not yet passed App Store review, and an update is expected in the next couple of days. 有知情人士向澎湃新闻表示，并非百度网盘业务特意绕开这一功能，而是适配新版本尚未通过 App Store 审核，预计这两天可更新。

Previously, some developers reverse-engineered and suggested that the advertising framework might switch to using other sensors to detect phone rotation when motion data is restricted. 此前，有开发者逆向分析认为，广告框架可能在运动数据受限时改用其他传感器判断手机转动。

The method provided by Baidu Netdisk's robot customer service to disable it is to turn off "Allow splash screen shake-to-jump advertisement" in the App's "My - Settings". 百度网盘机器人客服提供的关闭方式是，在 App「我的—设置」中关闭「允许展现开屏摇一摇广告」。

The system restriction for iOS 27.2 is located at "Settings - Privacy & Security - Motion & Fitness - Restrict Motion Data", where users can edit the list and add apps they wish to restrict. iOS 27.2 的系统限制则位于「设置—隐私与安全—运动与健身—限制动作数据」，用户可编辑名单，将希望限制的 App 加入其中。

item.title: 《纽约时报》等媒体起诉 Brave，指其抓取内容供 AI 使用
item.guid: 《纽约时报》等媒体起诉-Brave，指其抓取内容供-AI-使用
item.description:
According to The Verge, The New York Times, along with The New York Daily News, Chicago Tribune, and Orlando Sentinel, have each filed lawsuits, accusing Brave browser developers of scraping their reports without permission and providing content to users and AI companies through the browser and indexing services. 据 The Verge 报道，《纽约时报》以及《纽约每日新闻》《芝加哥论坛报》《奥兰多哨兵报》分别提起诉讼，指控 Brave 浏览器开发商未经许可抓取报道，并通过浏览器和索引服务向用户及 AI 公司提供内容。

Among them, lawsuits from three local newspapers allege that Brave commercializes its real-time content access capabilities for web indexing, using it for model training, answering user questions, or both; the lawsuits also claim its 'Paywall blocker' feature allows users to bypass paywalls. The AI companies mentioned include Anthropic, Perplexity, Mistral, xAI, and Cohere. 其中，三家地方报纸的诉状称，Brave 将其网页索引的实时内容访问能力商业化，用于模型训练、回答用户问题，或同时用于两者；诉状还指其「Paywall blocker」功能允许用户绕过付费墙。被提及的 AI 公司包括 Anthropic、Perplexity、Mistral、xAI 和 Cohere。

A spokesperson for The New York Times told The Verge that the newspaper had repeatedly asked Brave to cease the relevant activities. At the time of publication, Brave and other companies did not immediately respond to requests for comment; Perplexity, however, refuted the lawsuit, stating it contained erroneous information. 《纽约时报》发言人向 The Verge 表示，该报曾多次要求 Brave 停止相关行为。报道发稿时，Brave 等公司未立即回应置评请求；Perplexity 则反驳诉讼包含错误信息。

item.title: OLED 面板断货，理想 MEGA 部分批次先装 LCD 屏交付
item.guid: OLED-面板断货，理想-MEGA-部分批次先装-LCD-屏交付
item.description:
Tang Jing, head of product at Li Auto, stated on November 2 that the Samsung custom 29-inch 6K automotive-grade OLED panoramic screen for the front cabin of the new generation MEGA is experiencing a short-term supply shortage, expected to recover around the end of the year. Li Auto has decided to equip affected vehicles with L9 Livis-spec LCD panoramic screens first, delivering them as planned. 理想汽车产品负责人唐靖 11 月 2 日表示，新一代 MEGA 前舱的三星定制 29 英寸 6K 车规级 OLED 全景屏出现短期供应断货，预计年底左右恢复。理想决定对受影响车辆先装配 L9 Livis 同规格的 LCD 全景屏，按计划交付。

Affected vehicles are those produced between November 10 and December 17, corresponding to orders locked between September 11 at 17:06 and October 26 at 09:52. Li Auto stated that the software and interactive experience of both screen types are consistent; starting from March 1, 2027, the company will contact users in order of delivery to replace the screens with original OLED panels free of charge. 受影响的是 11 月 10 日至 12 月 17 日生产下线、对应 9 月 11 日 17:06 至 10 月 26 日 09:52 锁单的车辆。理想称，两种屏幕的软件和交互体验一致；从 2027 年 3 月 1 日起，公司将按交付顺序联系用户，免费换回原厂 OLED 屏。

Li Auto promises that the screen replacement will be implemented without damage, and software and subsequent OTA experiences will remain synchronized. After replacement, the screen will enjoy the same 5-year or 100,000-kilometer warranty as the entire vehicle. Affected users will also receive a 3-year MEGA exclusive premium car service package, including unlimited in-car data, unlimited maintenance pick-up/delivery, and air filter maintenance. Specific details will be pushed to users via the Li Auto App. 理想承诺换装无损实施，软件及后续 OTA 体验保持同步，换装后屏幕享受与整车同等的 5 年或 10 万公里质保。受影响用户还将获赠 3 年 MEGA 专属畅享版用车服务包，包含无限车机流量、无限次维保取送车和空调滤芯保养，具体细则将通过理想汽车 App 定向推送。

item.title: 傅利叶回应与 Meta 合作传闻：暂不方便回复
item.guid: 傅利叶回应与-Meta-合作传闻：暂不方便回复
item.description:
Regarding the news of a collaboration with Meta to develop humanoid robots, Fourier founder and CEO Gu Jie responded to a reporter from Yicai on November 2, stating that it was not convenient to comment at this time. 针对与 Meta 合作开发人形机器人的消息，傅利叶创始人、CEO 顾捷 11 月 2 日回复第一财经记者称，暂不方便回复。

The Information previously reported, citing informed sources, that Meta and Fourier developed a humanoid robot prototype internally codenamed Max in about three months, which was demonstrated to some employees in late August. The prototype is approximately 1.5 meters tall, weighs about 48 kilograms, is equipped with an NVIDIA Jetson Thor chip, and its five-fingered hand can pick up small bottles and toys. The Information 此前援引知情人士报道，Meta 与傅利叶用约 3 个月开发出内部代号为 Max 的人形机器人原型，并于 8 月底向部分员工展示。原型高约 1.5 米、重约 48 公斤，搭载英伟达 Jetson Thor 芯片，五指手能够拿起小瓶子和玩具。

The report stated that both parties began developing Max 2 in September, which will feature a redesigned torso, improved dual-hand manipulation capabilities, and added projection and sensors to assist with climbing stairs. A Meta spokesperson told the media that this collaboration with Fourier focuses on internal research and experimentation, with no plans to sell these prototypes. 报道称，双方已于 9 月 开始开发 Max 2，将重新设计躯干、改进双手操作能力，并增加投影和帮助上下楼梯的传感器。Meta 发言人向该媒体表示，这项与傅利叶合作的工作专注内部研究和实验，没有出售这些原型机的计划。

item.title: 名越工作室解散，相关公告登上日本《官报》
item.guid: 名越工作室解散，相关公告登上日本《官报》
item.description:
According to Japanese gaming media GAME Watch, the Japanese Official Gazette published on November 2 contained information about the dissolution of Nagoshi Studio: the company was dissolved based on a resolution from the shareholders' meeting on October 31. 据日本游戏媒体 GAME Watch 报道，11 月 2 日发行的日本《官报》刊登名越工作室解散信息：公司已根据 10 月 31 日股东大会决议解散。

Toshihiro Nagoshi previously participated in creating the 'Like a Dragon' series and formed Nagoshi Studio after leaving Sega. The team announced a new work, 'GANG OF DRAGON,' starring Ma Dong-seok, at the end of 2025. GAME Watch also noted that the studio's official website is currently inaccessible, and its official X account has not been updated since February 17. 名越稔洋此前参与打造《人中之龙》系列，离开世嘉后组建名越工作室。团队在 2025 年末公布了由马东锡出演的新作《GANG OF DRAGON》。GAME Watch 同时指出，工作室官网目前无法浏览，官方 X 账号自 2 月 17 日后未再更新。

item.title: 阿里云为达喀尔青奥会搭建赛事云，赛后将移交为国家云
item.guid: 阿里云为达喀尔青奥会搭建赛事云，赛后将移交为国家云
item.description:
Alibaba Cloud disclosed that the 2026 Dakar Youth Olympic Games have opened in Senegal. This is the first Olympic event held in Africa, and Alibaba Cloud built a dedicated Olympic cloud infrastructure for it. After the event, it will be entirely handed over to Senegal, transforming into a 'national cloud' to serve the local digital transformation. 阿里云披露，2026 年达喀尔青年奥林匹克运动会已在塞内加尔开幕。这是首个在非洲举办的奥运赛事，阿里云为其建设奥运专有云底座，赛事结束后将整体移交塞内加尔，转为服务当地数字化转型的「国家云」。

This platform deploys dual availability zones locally, supporting core services such as ticketing, e-visas, and one-stop athlete services. The ticketing system covers registration, schedule inquiry, booking, and on-site verification, supporting a million-ticket scale. Alibaba Cloud stated that it has completed multiple disaster recovery drills, and cloud broadcasting relies on OBS Cloud to transmit event footage globally. 这套平台在当地部署双可用区，承载票务、电子签证、运动员一站式服务等核心业务。票务系统覆盖注册、赛程查询、预订与现场核验，支撑百万张级别的票务规模；阿里云称已完成多次灾备演练，云转播则依托 OBS Cloud 向全球传送赛事画面。

A 'Hospitable Drum AI Experience Station' was also set up on-site: after visitors strike a physical Saba drum and take a photo, Wanxiang can generate a 10 to 15-second short video of them dressed in local traditional attire, drumming and celebrating; the Qianwen Q&A assistant is responsible for introducing the history of the Youth Olympics and event information. 现场还设置了「好客之鼓 AI 体验站」：观众敲击实体萨巴鼓并拍摄照片后，可由万相生成一段身着当地传统服饰、敲鼓欢庆的 10 至 15 秒短视频；千问问答助手负责介绍青奥会历史及赛事信息。

item.title: 香港金管局推出 SAGE 项目，探索 AI Agent 购物与支付
item.guid: 香港金管局推出-SAGE-项目，探索-AI-Agent-购物与支付
item.description:
The Hong Kong Monetary Authority announced on November 2 the launch of Project SAGE to support the exploration of agent-based finance applications and simultaneously establish a governance framework. Potential scenarios include consumer-facing agent shopping and daily payments, corporate procurement and treasury management, and machine-to-machine payment for digital services based on usage. 香港金融管理局 11 月 2 日宣布推出 SAGE 项目，支持代理式金融的应用探索，并同步建立管治框架。潜在场景包括面向消费者的代理购物和日常支付、企业采购与财资管理，以及机器之间按用量支付数字服务费用。

The project focuses on four directions: validating application scenarios, verifying agent identity and authorization, discussing interoperability standards, and outlining legal and regulatory frameworks. Specifically, the identity direction will research 'Know Your Agent (KYA)' measures and authentication mechanisms; the legal direction involves governance arrangements, liability allocation, and consumer protection. 项目聚焦四个方向：验证应用场景、核实代理身份与授权、讨论互通标准，以及梳理法律和监管框架。其中，身份方向将研究「认识你的代理（KYA）」措施和认证机制；法律方向涉及管治安排、责任划分与消费者保障。

The HKMA also established an expert group on agent-based finance, with members from financial institutions, technology service providers, professional service organizations, and academia, to support the project. 金管局同时成立代理式金融专家小组，成员来自金融机构、科技服务商、专业服务机构和学术界，为项目提供支持。

item.title: Anthropic 第三季度营收接近 170 亿美元，净亏损扩大
item.guid: Anthropic-第三季度营收接近-170-亿美元，净亏损扩大
item.description:
According to Bloomberg, Anthropic disclosed in a November 2 filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission that its third-quarter revenue, as of September 30, was nearly $17 billion, approximately 12 times that of the same period last year. 据彭博社报道，Anthropic 在 11 月 2 日提交美国证券交易委员会的文件中披露，截至 9 月 30 日的第三季度营收接近 170 亿美元，达到上年同期的约 12 倍。

The Claude developer's net loss for the same period was $23.3 billion, compared to a net loss of $12.1 billion in the same period last year. The financial update occurred while the company was preparing for its initial public offering. 这家 Claude 开发商同期净亏损为 233 亿美元，上年同期净亏损为 121 亿美元。财务更新发生在公司筹备首次公开募股期间。

item.title: 💡 Omdia：AI 眼镜的差异化要靠可靠体验与服务整合
item.guid: 💡-Omdia：AI-眼镜的差异化要靠可靠体验与服务整合
item.description:
Market research firm Omdia, in its latest analysis, believes that with the development of personal AI agents, competition in AI glasses will extend beyond hardware to model capabilities, cross-device, and cross-service integration. The prerequisite for differentiation is to provide a reliable and practical experience that is difficult for smartphones to achieve. 市场调研机构 Omdia 在最新分析中认为，随着个人 AI 智能体发展，AI 眼镜的竞争将从硬件进一步延伸到模型能力、跨设备和跨服务的整合，差异化的前提是提供手机难以实现的可靠、实用体验。

The firm cited Meta's plan to introduce its personal AI agent Muse into AI glasses as an example, pointing out that hands-free interaction and first-person visual information help the agent understand user intent and environment, reducing the burden of users explaining their needs; tasks can then be processed by the device or the cloud, or coordinated with other services. 该机构以 Meta 计划将个人智能体 Muse 引入 AI 眼镜为例指出，免手持交互和第一视角视觉信息，有助于智能体理解用户意图与环境，减少用户解释需求的负担；任务随后可由设备或云端处理，也可协调其他服务执行。

In the agency's view, this instant, natural interaction may make consumers willing to entrust more daily tasks to intelligent agents, including tasks they would not have entrusted to mobile voice assistants in the past. 在该机构看来，这种即时、自然的交互，可能让消费者愿意把更多日常任务交给智能体，包括过去不会交给手机语音助手的任务。

However, reliable execution, clear security boundaries, and consumer trust in personal data access are prerequisites for the expanded application of intelligent agents; Meta's past privacy controversies will increase the difficulty of building trust. 但可靠执行、清楚的安全边界与消费者对个人数据访问的信任，是智能体扩大应用的前提；Meta 过去的隐私争议会增加建立信任的难度。

The competitive path proposed by Omdia is not limited to large companies with self-developed models: other hardware manufacturers can cooperate with AI service providers like OpenAI and then compete with differentiated hardware. Omdia 提出的竞争路径也不限于拥有自研模型的大公司：其他硬件厂商可与 OpenAI 等 AI 服务商合作，再用差异化硬件参与竞争。

item.title: 第二代海豹 07 将于 11 月 5 日上市，首搭云辇-M 系统
item.guid: 第二代海豹-07-将于-11-月-5-日上市，首搭云辇-M-系统
item.description:
BYD's second-generation Seal 07 will be officially launched on November 5th. The new car has started blind pre-orders and is BYD's first model equipped with the Yunlian-M intelligent magnetorheological body control system. 比亚迪第二代海豹 07 将于 11 月 5 日正式上市。新车已开启盲订，是比亚迪首款搭载云辇-M 智能磁流变车身控制系统的车型。

The new car continues the Ocean Aesthetics 2.0 design, with dimensions of 5080/1960/1495mm (length/width/height) and a wheelbase of 2960mm. It offers six body colors and three interior color schemes. The cockpit is equipped with a floating central control screen, an LCD instrument panel, and a three-spoke steering wheel, along with a 20-speaker Devialet sound system; the front zero-gravity seats support ventilation, heating, and massage. 新车延续海洋美学 2.0 设计，长宽高为 5080/1960/1495mm，轴距 2960mm，提供六种车身颜色和三种内饰配色。座舱配备悬浮式中控屏、液晶仪表和三辐式方向盘，并提供 20 扬声器帝瓦雷音响；前排零重力座椅支持通风、加热和按摩。

The powertrain offers two options: plug-in hybrid and pure electric. According to the configuration disclosed by Yiche, the plug-in hybrid version is equipped with a 1.5T engine and a 160kW drive motor, a 38.029kWh battery, and a WLTC pure electric range of 245 kilometers; the pure electric version listed in the report has a peak motor power of 300kW. Blind pre-order benefits include priority production and delivery, and free customization. 动力提供插混、纯电两种选择。按易车披露配置，插混版搭载 1.5T 发动机和 160kW 驱动电机，配备 38.029kWh 电池，WLTC 纯电续航 245 公里；报道列出的纯电版电机峰值功率为 300kW。盲订权益包括优先排产提车和自由选配。

item.title: 问界发布 10 月出行报告：辅助驾驶里程占比 46.6%，活跃用户达 92.7 万
item.guid: 问界发布-10-月出行报告：辅助驾驶里程占比-46.6%，活跃用户达-92.7-万
item.description:
AITO released its October travel report: From October 1st to 31st, the total mileage of models equipped with assisted driving functions was 1.81 billion kilometers, with assisted driving mileage accounting for 46.6%. The number of active assisted driving users in that month was 927,000, accounting for 91.5% of the total users. 问界汽车发布 10 月出行报告：10 月 1 日至 31 日，搭载辅助驾驶功能车型的总行驶里程为 18.1 亿公里，辅助驾驶行驶里程占比为 46.6%。当月辅助驾驶活跃用户为 92.7 万，占用户总量的 91.5%。

The report shows that 402,000 users had assisted driving mileage accounting for more than half of their total; the average monthly assisted driving mileage per person was 910 kilometers, and the average usage time per person was 14.7 hours. 报告显示，有 40.2 万用户的辅助驾驶里程占比超过一半；月度人均辅助驾驶里程为 910 公里，人均使用时长为 14.7 小时。

The top three vehicles in cumulative assisted driving mileage are all from AITO M7: the 2026 AITO M7 recorded 18,892 kilometers, with assisted driving accounting for 98.5%; the M7 Ultra version recorded 17,194 kilometers, accounting for 94.8%; and the M7 EV 2026 version recorded 15,691 kilometers, accounting for 91.7%. 单车累计辅助驾驶里程前三名均来自问界 M7：2026 款问界 M7 为 18892 公里，辅助驾驶占比 98.5%；M7 Ultra 版为 17194 公里，占比 94.8%；M7 EV 2026 版为 15691 公里，占比 91.7%。

item.title: Kimi 发布游戏开发方案，可操作引擎并交付原生工程
item.guid: Kimi-发布游戏开发方案，可操作引擎并交付原生工程
item.description:
Moonshot AI's Kimi released its "Game Development and Creative Work Solution," which integrates gameplay verification, art production, engineering development, and publishing operations, based on Kimi K3.1 Pro, Kimi Code, Kimi Work, and professional software plugins. 月之暗面 Kimi 发布「游戏开发与创意工作解决方案」，基于 Kimi K3.1 Pro、Kimi Code、Kimi Work 和专业软件插件，将玩法验证、美术制作、工程开发及发行运营串联起来。

In the project initiation phase, the team can provide reference images, videos, and gameplay requirements. Kimi uses Godot to build playable prototypes, then runs the game, checks visuals and recordings, and modifies and retests upon discovering issues. In the art phase, existing projects can be operated via Blender plugins to check multi-perspective proportions, intersections, and materials, or to build scenes according to reference materials. 在立项阶段，团队可提供参考图、视频和玩法要求，由 Kimi 使用 Godot 搭建可试玩原型，再运行游戏、检查画面与录像，发现问题后修改复测。美术环节可通过 Blender 插件操作现有工程，检查多视角比例、穿插与材质，或按参考素材搭建场景。

For formal development, Kimi collaborates with Unity China's Tuanjie Codely Agent and Unity Engine: the model understands requirements, generates code, and analyzes test feedback, while the Agent builds scenes, modifies projects, and runs validations within the engine. Kimi states that in one demonstration, the system worked continuously for 20 hours without human intervention, delivering a natively developed project. It can also assist with gameplay debugging and scene building for Unreal Engine projects after gaining project access and command execution permissions. 正式开发方面，Kimi 与 Unity 中国的 Tuanjie Codely Agent、团结引擎协同：模型理解需求、生成代码并分析测试反馈，Agent 在引擎中搭场景、改工程和运行验证。Kimi 称，一次演示中系统无人工干预连续工作 20 小时，交付了可持续开发的原生工程。它也可在获得项目访问和命令执行权限后，协助 Unreal Engine 工程的玩法联调与场景搭建。

The operations phase covers advertising materials, organizing player feedback with sources, localization, and initial UGC screening. The team suggests piloting tasks with clear boundaries and easily verifiable results, with outcomes checked by personnel in corresponding roles. 运营环节则覆盖投放素材、带来源的玩家反馈整理、本地化与 UGC 初筛。团队建议从边界明确、结果易检查的任务试点，并由对应岗位人员检查成果。

item.title: DeepSeek Harness 加入创作者模式，可用对话制作插件
item.guid: DeepSeek-Harness-加入创作者模式，可用对话制作插件
item.description:
DeepSeek Harness launched "Creator Mode," allowing users to create plugins through natural language conversations to extend tools, skills, and application interfaces. The team demonstrated uses such as design workstations, sandbox games, and 3D visualization in the official demo. DeepSeek Harness 推出「创作者模式」，让用户通过自然语言对话制作插件，扩展工具、技能和应用界面。团队在官方演示中展示了设计工作台、沙盒游戏和 3D 可视化等用法。

The official release also included seven sets of demo prompts, covering landmark 3D exhibition halls, Transformer computation process visualization, full-application pixel-style interfaces, poster design, video editing, paper reading, and conversation statistics. Plugins can provide entry points in either the left or right sidebar, or be opened from within a conversation. 官方同时公开了七组演示提示词，涵盖地标 3D 展厅、Transformer 计算过程可视化、全应用像素风界面、海报设计、视频剪辑、论文阅读和会话统计。插件既可以在左侧栏或右侧栏提供入口，也可以从会话中打开。

Among them, the video workbench demo requirements include multi-video import, timeline editing, preview and export, and operating videos with natural language within a conversation. The official note states that some plugins have undergone multiple rounds of dialogue adjustments, so a single input of the same prompt may not reproduce the demo effect. 其中，视频工作台的演示要求包括多视频导入、时间轴剪辑、预览与导出，以及在会话中用自然语言操作视频。官方提示，部分插件经过多轮对话调整，单次输入同一提示词未必能重现演示效果。

item.title: 贾跃亭称 FFR 机器人 10 月销售及出货 351 台，累计达 1168 台
item.guid: 贾跃亭称-FFR-机器人-10-月销售及出货-351-台，累计达-1168-台
item.description:
Jia Yueting stated in the latest weekly report that FFR robot body sales and shipments in October were 351 units, setting a new monthly record, with cumulative sales and shipments reaching 1168 units, breaking the thousand-unit mark for the first time. 贾跃亭在最新一期周报中表示，FFR 机器人本体 10 月销售及出货量为 351 台，刷新单月纪录，累计销售及出货量达到 1168 台，首次突破千台。

He expects the average monthly sales and shipments in November and December to exceed 400 units, and will continue to strive for the annual target of approximately 2000 units. 他预计，11 月、12 月的月均销售及出货量将超过 400 台，并继续冲刺全年约 2000 台的目标。

The weekly report also announced that FFR and FFAI's New York region has begun operations and initiated investment promotion, with the first phase covering New York, New Jersey, Massachusetts, southwestern Connecticut, and eastern Pennsylvania, focusing on promoting regional business, investor and capital market communication, and government and public institution relations. Jia Yueting also stated that both companies have started talent recruitment for the New York region. 周报同时宣布，FFR 与 FFAI 的纽约大区开始运作并启动招商，首期覆盖纽约、新泽西、马萨诸塞州、康涅狄格西南部和宾夕法尼亚东部，重点推进区域业务、投资者与资本市场沟通，以及政府和公共机构关系。贾跃亭还表示，两家公司已开启纽约大区人才招聘。

item.title: 腾讯发布 Hyra 2.0，让科研 Agent 从解题走向造工具
item.guid: 腾讯发布-Hyra-2.0，让科研-Agent-从解题走向造工具
item.description:
Tencent Hunyuan released research Agent Hyra 2.0, expanding its goal to developing reusable scientific models, algorithms, and validation tools. The team hopes that the results from one research effort can be used for subsequent tasks and that the system can participate in the training infrastructure, data synthesis, and inference optimization of the next generation of Hy models. 腾讯混元发布科研 Agent Hyra 2.0，将目标扩展到研发可反复使用的科学模型、算法与验证工具。团队希望一次研究留下的成果能用于后续任务，并让系统参与下一代 Hy 模型的训练基础设施、数据合成和推理优化。

To support research lasting from several days to several weeks, Hyra 2.0 integrates with WeChat Work, computing platforms, and code repositories. Overall coordinates goals and resources, Mission manages the research roadmap, and Worker executes experiments. A task queue saves progress, and independent reviewers check code, logs, and raw results; however, significant computing power expenditure and shared knowledge synchronization still require manual approval. 为支持持续数天至数周的研究，Hyra 2.0 接入企业微信、计算平台和代码仓库，由 Overall 协调目标与资源、Mission 管理研究路线、Worker 执行实验。任务队列保存进展，独立复核者检查代码、日志和原始结果；较大算力开销及共享知识同步仍需人工审批。

Tencent's preliminary results include the protein inverse folding model HyInv, the protein language model HyPLM-Flash, the molecular simulation model HyFF, and the quantum error correction tool HyQEC. The team states that Hyra 2.0 completed the training and inference optimization of HyInv from scratch, increasing generation speed by 57 times compared to ProteinMPNN, and achieving better alignment between generated sequences and target structures. 腾讯公布的初步成果包括蛋白质逆折叠模型 HyInv、蛋白质语言模型 HyPLM-Flash、分子模拟模型 HyFF，以及量子纠错工具 HyQEC。团队称，Hyra 2.0 从头完成 HyInv 的训练与推理优化，相比 ProteinMPNN，生成速度提高 57 倍，生成序列与目标结构的吻合程度也更好。

Robot structure exploration has yielded the five-fingered "spiral ladder hand": in DR5 simulation evaluations, after policy fine-tuning with the same budget, the object rotation speed was 28.6% faster than the optimal design in the paper, though it has not yet been verified on a real machine. Related results will continue to be published on GitHub for community verification and reuse. 机器人结构探索则产出五指「旋梯手」：在 DR5 仿真评测中，经相同预算的策略微调后，物体旋转速度比论文最优设计快 28.6%，尚未经过真机验证。相关成果将持续公开到 GitHub，供社区检验与复用。

item.title: 优必选发布 Thinker-Sim，打通场景重建、数据合成与机器人评测
item.guid: 优必选发布-Thinker-Sim，打通场景重建、数据合成与机器人评测
item.description:
UBTECH has released the embodied AI simulation platform Thinker-Sim, centered on Real2Sim2Real, covering digital transformation of real-world scenarios, large-scale simulated data synthesis, and robot capability evaluation. 优必选发布具身智能仿真平台 Thinker-Sim，以 Real2Sim2Real 为核心，覆盖真实场景数字化、规模化仿真数据合成和机器人能力评测。

The platform uses self-developed Thinker-GS scene reconstruction algorithm and SimReady asset automatic generation technology to reconstruct factory production lines and commercial exhibition halls into digital twin environments, then load assets such as robots, production equipment, and personnel to combine training or testing scenarios. 平台采用自研 Thinker-GS 场景重建算法和 SimReady 资产自动生成技术，可将工厂产线、商业展厅重建为数字孪生环境，再加载机器人、生产设备和人员等资产，组合训练或测试场景。

The data stage supports multi-node parallel simulation; the evaluation stage covers tasks such as perception, navigation, and manipulation, and can randomly adjust environmental conditions like lighting, texture, and material to test the algorithm's robustness and generalization capabilities. 数据环节支持多节点并行仿真；评测环节覆盖感知、导航、操作等任务，并可随机调整光照、纹理、材质等环境条件，测试算法的鲁棒性与泛化能力。

Users can start simulations via standard task templates and parameter configurations, and view real-time screens, task status, and results. The platform also provides a visual workflow and a natural language entry point based on Ulab-Agent for creating scenarios, configuring environments, and orchestrating tasks. 用户可通过标准任务模板和参数配置启动仿真，并实时查看画面、任务状态与结果。平台还提供可视化工作流，以及基于 Ulab-Agent 的自然语言入口，用于创建场景、配置环境和编排任务。

item.title: 美团 LongCat-2.5 正式上线，支持视觉编程与长程工程任务
item.guid: 美团-LongCat-2.5-正式上线，支持视觉编程与长程工程任务
item.description:
Meituan LongCat API platform update logs show that LongCat-2.5 officially launched on November 2. Previously, LongCat-2.5-Preview was opened on September 25. 美团 LongCat API 平台更新日志显示，LongCat-2.5 于 11 月 2 日正式上线。此前，LongCat-2.5-Preview 已在 9 月 25 日开放。

The official summary of the new version's key features includes native multimodal capabilities, long-range agents, and cross-tool integration: the model combines visual understanding with agent programming for visual encoding, creative design, and 3D tasks; it handles complex codebases and complete project construction through multi-step reasoning, tool invocation, and end-to-end execution. 官方将新版重点概括为原生多模态、长程 Agent 和跨工具接入：模型结合视觉理解与智能体编程，用于视觉编码、创意设计和 3D 任务；通过多步推理、工具调用和端到端执行，处理复杂代码库与完整项目构建。

Developers can integrate LongCat-2.5 with Agent tools such as Claude Code, Codex, and Hermes for use in existing development workflows. 开发者可将 LongCat-2.5 接入 Claude Code、Codex、Hermes 等 Agent 工具，在现有开发流程中使用。

item.title: 曝三星 Galaxy Z Fold9 考虑恢复内屏屏下摄像头
item.guid: 曝三星-Galaxy-Z-Fold9-考虑恢复内屏屏下摄像头
item.description:
According to SamMobile, leakers claim that Samsung has decided to re-equip the Galaxy Z Fold9's inner foldable screen with an under-display camera. Samsung first introduced this design in the 2021 Galaxy Z Fold3, continued it until the Fold6, and then switched to a punch-hole front camera in the Fold7 to improve imaging quality. 据 SamMobile 报道，爆料者称三星已决定为 Galaxy Z Fold9 的折叠内屏重新配备屏下摄像头。三星最早在 2021 年的 Galaxy Z Fold3 引入这项设计，沿用至 Fold6，随后在 Fold7 改用挖孔前摄以改善成像质量。

The same leaker states that the new phone's upgrade focus will be on internal configurations, with minor external changes, an unfolded thickness of about 3.9mm, and a folded thickness of about 7.9mm. 同一爆料者称，新机升级重点将放在内部配置，外观改动较小，展开厚度约 3.9mm、折叠厚度约 7.9mm。

item.title: 国仪量子发布商品化核磁超低温探头与固体核磁波谱仪
item.guid: 国仪量子发布商品化核磁超低温探头与固体核磁波谱仪
item.description:
Guoyi Quantum released the CryoHe series helium-type NMR ultra-low temperature probe and the CAN-S series high-field solid-state NMR spectrometer at the Second Conference on Analytical Science and Instruments held in Wuhan on October 31. These are designed for high-sensitivity detection in liquid NMR and structural characterization of solid materials, respectively. 国仪量子在 10 月 31 日于武汉举行的第二届分析科学与仪器大会上，发布 CryoHe 系列氦型核磁超低温探头和 CAN-S 系列高场固体核磁共振波谱仪，分别面向液体核磁的高灵敏度检测与固体材料结构表征。

According to Analysis and Testing Encyclopedia, CryoHe adopts closed-cycle cryogenic cooling technology, allowing the core RF coil to operate at approximately 20K to reduce thermal noise in the signal chain, improving sensitivity by about 3 times compared to conventional room-temperature probes. The probe supports various nuclides, as well as automatic tuning and matching, and can be used for analyzing trace, low-concentration, and complex mixed samples. 据分析测试百科网介绍，CryoHe 采用闭循环低温冷却技术，使核心射频线圈工作于约 20K，以降低信号链路热噪声，灵敏度较常规室温探头提升约 3 倍。探头支持多种核素，以及自动调谐与匹配，可用于微量、低浓度及复杂混合样品的分析。

CAN-S is based on a distributed spectrometer architecture, targeting research in new energy battery materials, multiphase catalysis, and polymer materials. This release advances both the ultra-low temperature probe and solid-state NMR spectrometer product lines to the commercialization stage. CAN-S 则基于分布式谱仪架构，面向新能源电池材料、多相催化和高分子材料等研究。此次发布将超低温探头和固体核磁整机两条产品线推进到商品化阶段。

item.title: Affinity 免费一体化设计应用登陆 iPad
item.guid: Affinity-免费一体化设计应用登陆-iPad
item.description:
Canva has launched the new Affinity for iPad, integrating drawing, vector design, photo editing, and page layout into a single app. Individual users can freely use the core tools of four studios and start creating by logging into their Canva account; AI features in Canva AI Studio require a paid plan. Canva 推出新版 Affinity for iPad，将绘画、矢量设计、照片编辑与页面排版整合进同一款应用。个人用户可免费使用四个工作室的核心工具，登录 Canva 账号即可开始创作；Canva AI Studio 中的 AI 功能需要付费方案。

The iPad version adds Sketch Studio for touch and Apple Pencil, allowing users to sketch with editable brushes and then switch to Vector Studio to modify vector graphics node by node. Pixel and Layout studios handle photos and layout respectively, and the same .af file can be continuously edited between iPad and desktop. iPad 版新增面向触控与 Apple Pencil 的 Sketch Studio，可用可编辑画笔起稿，再切换到 Vector Studio 逐节点修改矢量图形。Pixel 与 Layout 工作室分别处理照片和排版，同一个 .af 文件可在 iPad 与桌面端之间继续编辑。

The app supports RAW non-destructive editing, layer composition, multi-page documents, and print output, and can also import files such as PSD, AI, INDD, IDML, PDF, SVG. The initial release does not yet include desktop features like Books, Batch, Data Merge, macro recording, and astrophotography studio, and requires iPadOS 18.0 or newer. 应用支持 RAW 无损编辑、图层合成、多页文档和印刷输出，也能导入 PSD、AI、INDD、IDML、PDF、SVG 等文件。首发版本尚不包含桌面版的 Books、Batch、Data Merge、宏录制和天文摄影工作室等功能，运行要求为 iPadOS 18.0 或更新版本。

item.title: 星巴克太妃家族 11 月 3 日回归，新增高蛋白拿铁与伯爵奶茶
item.guid: 星巴克太妃家族-11-月-3-日回归，新增高蛋白拿铁与伯爵奶茶
item.description:
Starbucks will launch its holiday season "Toffee Family" on November 3, featuring five beverages: the classic Toffee Nut Latte, a sugar-free version of the Toffee Nut Latte, the new Toffee Nut High Protein Latte, the Decaf Toffee Nut Latte, and the Toffee Nut Earl Grey Milk Tea. 星巴克将于 11 月 3 日推出节日季「太妃家族」，共五款饮品：经典太妃榛果拿铁、不另加糖版太妃榛果拿铁、全新太妃榛果高蛋白拿铁、低因太妃榛果拿铁，以及太妃榛果伯爵奶茶。

The high-protein version defaults to no added sugar and no whipped cream topping, containing approximately 20g of protein per grande hot drink according to the standard recipe; the decaf version caters to different caffeine needs. Store decaf coffee beans have been upgraded to the water process method since late October, with classic espresso, blonde espresso, and decaf beans continuing to offer different choices. 高蛋白版默认不额外加糖、不含稀奶油顶，按标准配方，每大杯热饮含约 20g 蛋白质；低因版则面向不同咖啡因需求。门店低因咖啡豆已从 10 月底起升级为水处理法，经典浓缩、金烘浓缩和低因豆继续提供不同选择。

This season will also feature Pork Floss and Scrambled Egg Soft European Buns, Toffee Nut Latte Cheesecake, and Golden Sand Soft Heart Star Tarts. In addition to four new red cups, the holiday packaging will also include Jay Chou lyric-themed red cups. More than 150 holiday-themed stores will be available nationwide, with the Shenzhen Shum Yip Upperhills store serving as the flagship holiday-themed store. 本季还将推出猪柳滑蛋软欧堡、太妃榛果芝士蛋糕和金沙软心星形挞。节日包装除四款新红杯外，还有周杰伦歌词主题红杯，全国将有逾 150 家节日主题门店，深圳深业上城店作为节日主题旗舰店呈现。

item.title: 李佳琦直播间半小时卖出 2 万亿 Token
item.guid: 李佳琦直播间半小时卖出-2-万亿-Token
item.description:
On the evening of November 2nd, Qianwen Office Tokens were launched in Li Jiaqi's live broadcast room. According to Yicai Global, within half an hour of sales, 100,000 monthly personal membership cards for Qianwen Office were sold in the live broadcast room, corresponding to approximately 2 trillion Tokens in total. Chen Yusen, CEO of Qianwen Office, also appeared in the live broadcast room to introduce daily AI office usage scenarios. 11 月 2 日晚，李佳琦直播间上架千问办公 Token。据第一财经报道，开卖半小时，直播间售出 10 万份千问办公个人会员月卡，累计对应约 2 万亿 Token。千问办公 CEO 陈宇森也来到直播间，介绍 AI 办公的日常使用场景。

This year for Double Eleven, Token top-up and subscription packages have entered e-commerce shelves. According to an interview report by Xinhua News Agency, Tmall launched its Token Recharge Center on September 3rd, integrating vendors such as DeepSeek, Alibaba Cloud, Zhipu, and Kimi. MiniMax also opened its official brand flagship store. Users can purchase pay-as-you-go top-up vouchers, or fixed-quota monthly and annual subscriptions. 今年双十一，Token 充值与订阅套餐已进入电商货架。据新华社采访报道，天猫自 9 月 3 日上线 Token 充值中心，接入 DeepSeek、阿里云、智谱、Kimi 等厂商，MiniMax 也开出品牌官方旗舰店。用户可购买按量付费充值券，或固定额度的包月、包年订阅。

Interviewed video creators stated that complex scenes and action storyboards increase Token consumption, and fixed packages may not fit the work rhythm. Regarding the difficulty in comparing Token consumption and billing rules across different models, Wang Jiandong, Deputy Director of the National Information Center's Big Data Development Department, suggested unifying measurement standards, establishing conversion criteria, standardizing billing disclosures, and introducing third-party verification. 受访视频创作者表示，复杂场景和动作分镜会增加 Token 消耗，固定套餐未必贴合工作节奏。针对不同模型消耗和计费规则难以比较的问题，国家信息中心大数据发展部副主任王建冬建议统一计量口径、建立换算标准，并规范计费披露、引入第三方核验。

item.title: 北京公布智能眼镜消费指南，购新补贴最高 500 元
item.guid: 北京公布智能眼镜消费指南，购新补贴最高-500-元
item.description:
The Beijing Municipal Bureau of Commerce released the "Policy Guide for Promoting Smart Glasses Consumption," outlining current support policies from seven aspects: new purchase subsidies, first store/first launch, brand collaborations, international consumption scenarios, departure tax refunds, digital transformation, and international market expansion. The document was drafted on October 30th. 北京市商务局公布《促进智能眼镜消费政策指南》，从购新补贴、首店首发、品牌联名、国际化消费场景、离境退税、数字化转型和国际市场开拓七个方向梳理现行支持政策。文件成文于 10 月 30 日。

Consumers who purchase eligible smart glasses will receive a 15% subsidy based on the final sales price after deducting all discounts, with a maximum of 500 yuan per item. For enterprises that open eligible first stores, flagship stores, or innovative concept stores in Beijing, host new product launches or premieres, develop IP merchandise, or open themed or co-branded stores, the corresponding policies offer a maximum reward of 1 million yuan. 消费者购买符合条件的智能眼镜，按扣除各环节优惠后的最终销售价格享受 15% 补贴，每件最高 500 元。在京开设符合条件的首店、旗舰店、创新概念店，举办新品首发首秀，以及开发 IP 周边、开设主题或联名店的企业，对应政策均设最高 100 万元奖励。

The guide also supports key foreign-related consumption areas in creating international consumption experience spaces, with a maximum support of 20 million yuan for eligible projects; digital transformation projects are supported by no more than 50% of the approved actual total investment, with a maximum of 1 million yuan per enterprise. 指南还支持重点涉外消费区域打造国际化消费体验空间，对符合条件的项目最高支持 2000 万元；数字化转型项目按不超过审定实际投资总额的 50% 支持，单家企业最高 100 万元。

item.title: 《影之刃零》72 小时销量突破 400 万套
item.guid: 《影之刃零》72-小时销量突破-400-万套
item.description:
The official "Phantom Blade Zero" announced on November 2nd that the game's sales across all platforms exceeded 4 million units within 72 hours of its release. Jiemian News estimates that based on the standard edition's price of 268 yuan in the domestic market, the corresponding sales revenue has surpassed 1 billion yuan. 《影之刃零》官方 11 月 2 日宣布，游戏发售后 72 小时全平台销量突破 400 万套。界面新闻按国区标准版 268 元的定价估算，对应销售收入已超过 10 亿元。

The game's popularity also drove up the A-share gaming sector. Jiemian News statistics show that as of the close on November 2nd, the Tonghuashun Gaming Index rose by 8.91%, with several gaming stocks hitting their daily limit. S-GAME also stated that it has recorded player feedback and begun optimization, prioritizing the fixing of a batch of obvious bugs in the near future. 游戏热度也带动 A 股游戏板块上行。界面新闻统计，截至 11 月 2 日收盘，同花顺游戏指数上涨 8.91%，多只游戏股涨停。灵游坊同时表示，已记录玩家反馈并开始优化，将于近期优先修复一批明显 Bug。

This dark martial arts action-adventure game, developed by Beijing S-GAME, was released on October 29th on Steam, Epic, WeGame, and PS5. Players take on the role of a swordsman with only 66 days left to live, uncovering a martial arts conspiracy while being hunted. 这款由北京灵游坊开发的暗黑武侠动作冒险游戏，于 10 月 29 日在 Steam、Epic、WeGame 和 PS5 发售。玩家扮演仅余 66 天生命的剑客，在追杀中揭开武林阴谋。

item.title: 10 月电影票房降至 20.46 亿元，创近十年同期新低
item.guid: 10-月电影票房降至-20.46-亿元，创近十年同期新低
item.description:
According to Caixin, citing data from the National Film Special Fund Office, national box office revenue in October 2026 was 2.046 billion yuan, a new low for the same period in nearly a decade. The report attributes this performance to lower-than-expected box office during the National Day holiday and the lack of popular new films to drive viewership after the holiday. 据财新引用国家电影专资办数据报道，2026 年 10 月全国电影票房为 20.46 亿元，创近十年同期新低。报道将这一表现归因于国庆档票房偏低，以及假期后缺乏热门新片带动观影。

From October 26th to November 1st, the national weekly box office was 179 million yuan, a 10% decrease month-on-month, marking the second consecutive week below 200 million yuan. Three National Day holiday films, "Resident Evil: Outbreak Night," "Traces of the Detective," and "What Do You Mean Couple," still contributed 60% of the total box office for that week. 10 月 26 日至 11 月 1 日，全国周票房为 1.79 亿元，环比下滑 10%，连续第二周不足 2 亿元。《生化危机：爆发夜》《神探之痕迹》和《什么意思夫妇》三部国庆档影片，仍贡献了当周总票房的 60%。

In the first three quarters, national box office revenue was 29.581 billion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 29%; the number of moviegoers was 751 million, a year-on-year decrease of over 200 million. Caixin's review of the third-quarter reports disclosed on October 29th found that among 14 companies with related businesses, only two saw year-on-year revenue growth and two saw profit growth. 前三季度，全国电影票房为 295.81 亿元，同比下滑 29%；观影人次为 7.51 亿，同比减少超过 2 亿。财新梳理 10 月 29 日披露的三季报发现，14 家有相关业务的公司中，仅两家营收同比增长、两家利润增长。

item.title: 《波西·杰克逊》第三季发布正式预告，11 月 20 日开播
item.guid: 《波西·杰克逊》第三季发布正式预告，11-月-20-日开播
item.description:
The first full trailer for "Percy Jackson" Season 3 has been released and will premiere on Disney+ on November 20th. This season is adapted from Rick Riordan's third book in the original series, "The Titan's Curse." Percy and his companions will embark on a journey to rescue Annabeth and face the looming war between the gods and Titans. 《波西·杰克逊》第三季发布首支完整预告，将于 11 月 20 日在 Disney+ 开播。本季改编自 Rick Riordan 原著系列第三部《巨神之咒》，波西一行将踏上营救安娜贝丝的旅程，并面对诸神与泰坦之间逐渐逼近的战争。

Walker Scobell, Leah Sava Jeffries, and others continue to star, with Tamara Smart playing Thalia, daughter of Zeus. The trailer also introduces Nico and Bianca di Angelo, two children of Hades, and new threats like the bronze giant Talos. Walker Scobell、Leah Sava Jeffries 等继续出演，Tamara Smart 饰演宙斯之女塔莉娅。预告首次展示 Nico 和 Bianca di Angelo 两名冥王子女，也带来青铜巨人 Talos 等新威胁。

The new lineup of gods includes Kate McKinnon as Aphrodite, Ming-Na Wen as Hera, Dafne Keen as Artemis, and Jennifer Beals as Demeter. 新加入的神祇阵容包括 Kate McKinnon 饰演阿佛洛狄忒、温明娜饰演赫拉、Dafne Keen 饰演阿尔忒弥斯，以及 Jennifer Beals 饰演得墨忒耳。

Anthropic DeepSeek Harness MacBook Pro OpenAI 屏下摄像头
